text:
sophie: FYI customer (Acme Health) filed an onboarding request for AtlasX-34B. Wants private deployment in our VPC, 4-bit quant (per-channel), target ~300 QPS, latency p95 <= 120ms. They also want before/after eval vs their current prod model and a basic safety sweep. @ml-oncall-bot can you triage?

ml-oncall-bot: Thanks! Intake recorded. Assigned to @kai. Priority: unconfirmed. Add tags: customer, private, quant, eval.

kai: Thanks @sophie. Quick Qs: 1) Do they have the model artifacts (hf/torchscript/tar)? 2) Representative prompt set or eval suite? 3) Contract/priority level?

sophie: They sent a tar + manifest to our secure bucket: s3://acme-health/models/atlasx-34b/v1/model.tar.gz. Eval prompts: internal link (redacted) — mostly clinical summarization & triage flows. Priority: revenue-impacting pilot but not urgent (can put in 2-week window).

jess: Do we have a constraint on quant method? Customer asked for 4-bit but is GPTQ acceptable or do they require custom AWQ? Also need to know acceptable degradation: no >2% rouge drop vs their prod model.

kai: Good. Tentative plan: 1) smoke load in a dev cluster, 2) run float perf profile, 3) try 4-bit GPTQ nf4 per-channel, 4) run evals + regressions, 5) perf ramp for QPS. Smoke command I'll run: ```runtest --model s3://acme-health/models/atlasx-34b/v1 --mode smoke --device cuda --batch 1```

omar: FYI for perf we should budget: initial profiling on 4xH100-80GB or 8xA100-80GB depending on kv-cache usage. If they expect 300 QPS with p95 120ms we might need sharded kv/cache. Also confirm sequence length (their eval uses up to 1024 tokens?).

sophie: seq len typically 512, but a few cases to 1024. Customer confirmed per-channel 4-bit is acceptable; they prefer GPTQ if faster turnaround. They want the before/after eval CSV and latency + token-cost breakdown.

kai: tagging @jess for eval metrics. Also adding checklist to this thread: - confirm artifacts integrity - model load smoke - float perf baseline - quant run(s) (gtpq nf4, maybe awq) - eval run + diffs - cost/latency report - canary private deploy

jess: For evals we'll compare against their prod model: metrics = ROUGE-L, exact-match where applicable, avg_confidence, hallucination-rate (manual subset). Also run embedding-similarity drift tests. I'll need sample labels for clinical summary subset.

ml-oncall-bot: Update: intake -> triage assigned to kai. Workflow ticket created: INF-2026-1123. ETA for first-smoke: 48h from assignment.

kai: Scheduling smoke on dev cluster tomorrow morning. Will post logs and perf numbers to the ticket. If we hit >3% degradation on rouge we'll iterate quant settings (per-channel vs per-tensor, symmetric vs asymmetric).

sophie: Thanks all. Please flag any infra blockers early — customer legal requires KMS audit enabled for keys.

jess: Noted. I'll prep eval harness and request labels from customer.

omar: If we need to fallback to higher precision for canary, propose 8-bit or hybrid (kv in fp16). Keep me looped for capacity changes.

sophie: great, appreciate it :thumbsup:
